page.overview:
Who is Anthony Hopkins?

image=250px| name=Anthony Hopkins| sex =| status=| hair=Gray| age=75| job=Actor| relatives=| appearance="A Star Is Burns"| voiced by=Hank Azaria

He came to audition for Mr. Burns' part for A Burns for All Seasons, wheeled in restrained a la Hannibal Lecter. He said "Excellent." and hissed, but was denied.

He is credited as 'Corky' in the mock film The Poke of Zorro. Funnily enough, Hopkins plays a character named Corky in the 1978 film [https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0077889/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_7 Magic].

He appears to live in the house opposite of 742 Evergreen Terrace. He was once playing with a remote control car when Luigi told him that his pizza would be late. Hopkins angrily shouted "Damn you. Damn you to Hell!"
